blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 50-year-old barangay chairman was shot dead at his residence in Sto. Tomas, Batangas on Thursday morning. Police have not yet released an official report on the incident. However, local media reports identified the victim as Dennis Austria, incumbent chairman of Barangay Sta. Anastacia. According to the reports, Austria was inside his house in a subdivision when an armed man shot him shortly after 6 a.m. READ: Maguindanao del Norte village chair shot dead in Sultan Kudarat The gunman fled on a motorcycle driven by an accomplice.
